items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1969-12-04
items.q: afterwards I put him in the union at 16, he's a builder, but he loves to play music. I believe he played for nothing.

ctx.x: As near as I could tell. He called me the other night. He said, Dad. Oh, loud too.

He said, you were thinking of me. I said, how do you know? He said, ESP. I said, ESP, you're drunk. Just like that. Me! Screaming. Then he goes on. And I've got to listen to his war record again. Concussion in the brain. He missed nine jobs and I took it. You're drunk, just like that. Me, screaming. Then he goes on, and I've gotta listen to his war record again. Concussion in the brain. He missed nine jobs, and I took it. But one night, he went off on intermission, didn't come back. I found out he was in jail,…
He says, are you not a trumpet?
